tables.title: GA B: selected source-linked recall facts (unverified)

cells: Narasimham Committee I
Its recommendations included lower SLR and greater private/foreign-bank entry.
Unverified compilation. Static history; recommendations, not today's operative banking rules.
Undated banking compilation; historical recommendation.
Narasimham Committee II
The 1998 committee favoured public-sector-bank consolidation.
Unverified compilation. Static history; distinguish the second committee from the first.
Committee year: 1998; source edition undated.
Canara Bank headquarters
Bengaluru, Karnataka.
Unverified compilation. Static institution matching; not a branch-location fact.
Undated banking compilation.
Punjab National Bank headquarters
New Delhi.
Unverified compilation. Static institution matching; avoid confusing it with Punjab & Sind Bank, also listed in New Delhi.
Undated banking compilation.
Financial Stability Report
RBI publishes the FSR twice yearly; it assesses systemic risks and resilience.
Unverified compilation. Report identity; do not treat it as a monetary-policy announcement.
Report labelled June 2026; frequency is a static descriptor.
FSDC versus a regulator
FSDC is a non-statutory coordination body chaired by the Union Finance Minister.
Unverified compilation. Static mandate; coordinating regulators does not make it the banking regulator.
June 2026 FSR compilation; institution established in 2010.
FSDC Sub-Committee
The RBI Governor chairs the operational/technical sub-committee.
Unverified compilation. Static chair distinction: not the chair of the full FSDC.
June 2026 FSR compilation.
Systemic Risk Survey
The compilation groups risks as global, financial, macroeconomic, institutional and general.
Unverified compilation. Survey categories; not five individual banks or five regulatory authorities.
June 2026 FSR compilation.
DICGC insurance ceiling
The compilation states cover of up to Rs 5 lakh per depositor per bank.
Unverified compilation. Rule snapshot; not per account. Aggregation, capacity/right and exclusions need current DICGC rules.
June 2026 compilation; not a freshly verified operative-rule check.
IFSCA mandate
IFSCA is the unified financial-services regulator for India's IFSC.
Unverified compilation. Static jurisdiction distinction; IFSC supervision is not all domestic banking supervision.
June 2026 FSR compilation.
CIRP under IBC
Corporate resolution seeks to revive viable distressed firms rather than default immediately to liquidation.
Unverified compilation. Static legal objective; not a promise that every company will be rescued.
IBC identified as 2016; June 2026 compilation.
Electronic Gold Receipts
EGRs are SEBI-regulated exchange-traded securities representing gold held in dematerialised form.
Unverified compilation. Instrument distinction; not a Sovereign Gold Bond or a jewellery purchase.
October 2026 edition; accompanying partnership's exact event date unspecified.
Programmable digital rupee
Bank of India's reported feature permits scheduled e-rupee transfers and purpose-restricted spending.
Unverified compilation. News claim, not established rollout coverage; distinguish wallet functionality from ordinary bank deposits.
October 2026 edition; launch day not supplied on cited page.
PPF rate snapshot
The October compilation reports a 7.1% rate for Q3 FY2026-27.
Unverified compilation. Unverified rate snapshot, not permanent. The preceding page's quarter-end date says 30 December: do not rely on that date.
October 2026 edition; stated applicability begins 1 October 2026.
Sovereign Gold Bond coupon
The scheme compilation states a fixed 2.50% annual coupon on the initial investment.
Unverified compilation. Historical product terms; not a forecast of gold returns or evidence that a new tranche is open.
Undated schemes compilation; no current issuance date established.
SGB maturity versus early redemption
The compilation distinguishes eight-year maturity from permitted premature redemption after five years.
Unverified compilation. Product-term distinction; redemption windows and issue terms still require checking.
Undated schemes compilation; not a newly announced tenor.
SGB redemption tax distinction
The source distinguishes taxable interest from an individual's capital-gains exemption on redemption.
Unverified compilation. Legal/tax snapshot only; do not extend redemption treatment to exchange sales or every investor type.
Undated schemes compilation; current tax-law position not authenticated.
JNPA–IFC blue financing
The October edition reports a US$70 million financing arrangement for shore-power infrastructure.
Unverified compilation. News financing amount, not project cost or realised emissions savings; no official confirmation performed.
October 2026 edition; event day unspecified; January 2028 is a stated completion target.

tables.title: GA P: selected source-linked recall facts (unverified)

cells: PM-KISAN beneficiary unit
The source defines a landholding farmer family as husband, wife and minor children with cultivable land in land records.
Unverified compilation. Eligibility snapshot; landholding alone does not override exclusions.
Undated Part 1 compilation, with nearby progress references through February 2025.
PM-KISAN benefit
The listed benefit is Rs 6,000 per eligible family yearly, paid in three Rs 2,000 instalments.
Unverified compilation. Income transfer, not a crop loan; amounts are per family, not per hectare.
Undated Part 1 compilation; no November 2026 benefit revision verified.
PM-KISAN pension exclusion
The source excludes retired pensioners receiving Rs 10,000 or more monthly, except the specified MTS/Class IV/Group D category.
Unverified compilation. Threshold plus exception; do not drop the exemption or confuse monthly pension with annual support.
Undated scheme-rule snapshot.
PM-KISAN income-tax exclusion
A family is excluded where a member paid income tax in the last assessment year.
Unverified compilation. Specific exclusion in the compilation; assessment year is not the same as the current calendar year.
Undated scheme-rule snapshot; verify current guidelines for applications.
PM-KISAN: three different dates
The source separates effective date (1 December 2018), announcement (1 February 2019) and launch (24 February 2019).
Unverified compilation. Do not substitute launch for retrospective applicability.
Historical dates as listed in Part 1; source edition undated.
PMJDY basic account
The scheme's basic savings account does not require a minimum balance.
Unverified compilation. Account feature; not a waiver of every service condition or a promise of unlimited facilities.
Undated scheme-rule snapshot; launch year listed as 2014.
PMJDY overdraft
The compilation lists an overdraft up to Rs 10,000 for eligible account holders aged 18–65.
Unverified compilation. Credit subject to eligibility, not a cash grant; a minor's account does not imply overdraft eligibility.
Undated scheme-rule snapshot; operational conditions not newly verified.
PMJDY RuPay accident cover
The source distinguishes Rs 1 lakh cover from Rs 2 lakh for new accounts opened after 28 August 2018.
Unverified compilation. Date-conditioned insurance claim; card-use and other policy conditions are not established by this short fact.
Historical threshold date: 28 August 2018; current policy wording unverified.
MUDRA Shishu category
Shishu covers loans up to Rs 50,000.
Unverified compilation. Loan category, not a subsidy entitlement; lender appraisal still matters.
Undated Part 1 compilation.
MUDRA Kishore versus Tarun
Kishore: above Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh; Tarun: above Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh.
Unverified compilation. Use the lower-bound exclusions and upper-bound inclusions; these are loan bands.
Undated Part 1 compilation.
MUDRA Tarun Plus
The listed band is above Rs 10 lakh to Rs 20 lakh, for entrepreneurs who successfully repaid a previous Tarun loan.
Unverified compilation. Conditional eligibility, not a universal Rs 20 lakh limit for first-time applicants.
Source says introduced October 2024; exact notification/effective day not supplied.
PKVY purpose
Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana promotes sustainable organic farming.
Unverified compilation. Agricultural support, not a general farmer income-transfer scheme.
Source lists launch in 2015–16 and implementation references as of February 2025.
PKVY certification approach
The compilation describes participatory PGS certification supporting domestic organic-produce marketing.
Unverified compilation. Certification approach; do not assume PGS automatically meets every export-market requirement.
Undated scheme compilation; February 2025 context.
PKVY funding shares
The source lists Centre:State shares of 60:40 generally and 90:10 for North-Eastern/Himalayan states; UTs receive full central funding.
Unverified compilation. Source-stated funding pattern; verify the applicable guideline/version rather than generalising to every farm scheme.
Undated Part 1 compilation; current funding order not authenticated.
PM-JAY hospital cover
The compilation lists Rs 5 lakh per eligible family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
Unverified compilation. Health cover, not cash paid to each member; eligibility and newer extension rules require separate checks.
Undated Part 1 compilation; not a complete November 2026 eligibility guide.
PM-JAY implementation
The National Health Authority coordinates nationally; State Health Agencies manage state implementation.
Unverified compilation. Implementing-body distinction, not a ministry-name substitution.
Undated Part 1 compilation.
PM-JAY pre-existing conditions
The source says pre-existing illnesses of eligible beneficiaries are covered from enrolment.
Unverified compilation. No waiting-period distinction in this compilation; do not infer universal eligibility or coverage of every treatment.
Undated Part 1 compilation; current package rules unverified.

tables.title: GA E: selected source-linked recall facts (unverified)

cells: Fiscal Health Index: publisher and period
The source attributes FHI 2026 to NITI Aayog and says it evaluates FY2023-24 state finances.
Unverified compilation. Edition year is not the financial year being measured.
Edition labelled 2026; reference FY2023-24.
FHI comparison groups
The compilation ranks major states separately from North-Eastern/Himalayan states.
Unverified compilation. Do not combine the two ranking tables into one national ordinal list.
2026-labelled edition; FY2023-24 data.
FHI five dimensions
Listed dimensions are expenditure quality, revenue mobilisation, fiscal prudence, debt index and debt sustainability.
Unverified compilation. Composite-index architecture, not five equal weights established here.
2026-labelled edition; FY2023-24 data.
FHI data source
The compilation identifies CAG budgetary-transaction data as the basis for the fiscal assessment.
Unverified compilation. CAG is the stated data source; NITI Aayog is the report publisher.
2026-labelled edition; state transactions for FY2023-24.
FHI score direction
A higher score indicates greater fiscal robustness in this framework.
Unverified compilation. Not a measure of state income or a credit-rating guarantee; image-only rankings were not transcribed.
2026-labelled edition; FY2023-24 data.
World Investment Report
UN Trade and Development (UNCTAD) publishes this annual report on FDI trends and investment policy.
Unverified compilation. Report–publisher–indicator matching; FDI is not the same as portfolio flows.
Report labelled 2026; publication identity is the static component.
WIR sustainable-investment headline
The compilation describes an uneven recovery, with transport, water, health and education lagging.
Unverified compilation. Qualitative report claim, not an independently confirmed global trend or uniform country outcome.
2026-labelled report; surrounding discussion concerns 2025 investment.
SOFI producing organisations
SOFI is jointly produced by FAO, IFAD, UNICEF, WFP and WHO and tracks hunger, food insecurity and nutrition.
Unverified compilation. Publisher/indicator matching; do not attribute it to only one health or agriculture body.
Report labelled 2026; no independent release authentication.
SOFI hunger headline: source claim
The compilation gives a 2025 hunger point estimate of 645 million, within a 608–696 million range.
Unverified compilation. Unestablished numeric claim: preserve the uncertainty range and verify the underlying release before memorising.
2026-labelled edition; estimate refers to 2025, not 2026.
Cost of a healthy diet: units
The compilation reports PPP $4.28 for 2025, distinct from a market-exchange-rate US-dollar cost.
Unverified compilation. Numeric/unit claim remains unestablished; the cited passage does not explicitly state the time/person denominator.
2026-labelled edition; diet-cost reference year 2025.
WEO versus WEO Update
The IMF's full WEO is described as April/October, with January/July interim forecast updates.
Unverified compilation. Publication schedule, not four full editions; stale membership counts on the page are intentionally not retained.
Compilation labelled July 2026 Update.
WEO growth forecast: source claim
The compilation projects global GDP growth of 3.0% in 2026 and 3.4% in 2027.
Unverified compilation. Unestablished forecast, not an outcome; unusually specific geopolitical assumptions on this page need release-level checking.
July 2026-labelled Update; forecast years 2026 and 2027.
WHO–UNICEF JMP
The October edition discusses JMP monitoring of school water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH).
Unverified compilation. Indicator scope is schools; do not substitute household WASH access.
October 2026 monthly edition; school-data discussion references 2025.
JMP India sanitation headline: source claim
The edition reports 50 million Indian children without school sanitation services out of 244 million globally.
Unverified compilation. Unestablished compilation estimate; children are the unit, not schools. The page separately notes hygiene-data limitations.
October 2026 edition; claim explicitly refers to 2025.
Exports: goods plus services
The edition reports US$242.6 billion of combined exports in July–September 2026, up 15.84% year on year.
Unverified compilation. Unestablished news statistic; combined exports are not merchandise exports alone or a full-year total.
October 2026 edition; reference quarter July–September 2026.

IBRD supports middle-income and creditworthy low-income countries with financing and advice.

IFC mandate
IFC focuses on private-sector development in developing countries through finance, capital mobilisation and advice.

tables.title: GA T: selected source-linked recall facts (unverified)

cells: CAG–BHASHINI Anuvaad
The edition reports a CAG/DIBD language-AI collaboration for translation of official audit documents.
Unverified compilation. Reported use case, not an audit opinion generated by AI; DIBD is under Digital India Corporation/MeitY.
October 2026 edition; the passage places the ceremony in September 2026, not October.
Indigenous protective glass R&D
The edition links DRDO and CSIR-CGCRI to lightweight bulletproof-glass development for armoured vehicles.
Unverified compilation. Development project, not proof of completed induction or universal ballistic protection.
October 2026 edition; agreement/event day unspecified.
HAPS developer and purpose
The edition identifies ADRDE, Agra, under DRDO, as developing a long-endurance stratospheric surveillance platform.
Unverified compilation. Reported development/testing; avoid converting a brief trial into demonstrated long endurance.
October 2026 edition; trial date not supplied on cited page.
National maritime SAREX
The edition identifies the Indian Coast Guard as conducting the national maritime search-and-rescue exercise off Odisha.
Unverified compilation. Exercise purpose/operator distinction; not a bilateral combat exercise.
October 2026 edition; described as SAREX-2026, exact exercise days unspecified.
EyeROV TROUT
The edition describes underwater remotely operated vehicles for naval inspection, surveillance and recovery.
Unverified compilation. ROV is not an autonomous surface vessel; delivery/indigenous-first claims are not independently confirmed.
October 2026 edition; delivery day unspecified.
SAKSHAM defence accounting
The edition describes SAKSHAM integrating defence accounts and payment information with the Army's IAFIS.
Unverified compilation. Digital financial-administration tool, not a weapon system; deployment scope unverified.
October 2026 edition; launch day unspecified on cited page.

tables.title: GA N: selected source-linked recall facts (unverified)

cells: UNEP headquarters
The compilation places UNEP in Nairobi, Kenya, and dates its start to 1972.
Unverified compilation. Static environmental institution fact, not a convention secretariat location.
Undated treaties compilation.
IPCC sponsoring organisations
The compilation identifies UNEP and the World Meteorological Organization as the bodies that formed the IPCC.
Unverified compilation. Scientific assessment institution; not itself a climate treaty or national regulator.
Undated treaties compilation.
Cartagena Protocol
The CBD-linked Cartagena Protocol concerns biosafety in handling living modified organisms.
Unverified compilation. Protocol-purpose matching; distinguish it from access-and-benefit sharing.
Undated compilation; historical protocol, not a new October policy.
Nagoya Protocol
The CBD-linked Nagoya Protocol concerns access to genetic resources and sharing benefits from their use.
Unverified compilation. Not the Cartagena biosafety protocol or the Aichi target framework.
Undated treaties compilation.
Vienna Convention versus Montreal Protocol
The source distinguishes the ozone-protection framework from the Montreal Protocol's controlled-substance phase-out obligations.
Unverified compilation. Legal roles differ; simplified notes do not establish every party's timetable.
Historical instruments: Vienna 1985; Montreal 1987, as listed.
Ramsar Convention
Ramsar concerns wetland conservation and wise use; the source lists adoption on 2 February 1971.
Unverified compilation. Wetland treaty, not exclusively a bird-protection agreement.
Historical adoption date; not the source edition date.
Ramsar secretariat versus depositary
The compilation places the secretariat in Gland and identifies UNESCO as depositary.
Unverified compilation. Institutional roles, not two alternative headquarters; current arrangements unverified.
Undated treaties compilation.
CITES scope
CITES regulates international trade in wild species and their products to avoid threatening survival.
Unverified compilation. Trade focus; not a blanket worldwide ban on every wildlife-related activity.
Undated treaties compilation; no current species-list amendment checked.
PRAMAAN forest certification
The edition links PRAMAAN forest-management certification under IFWCS to National Working Plan Code 2023.
Unverified compilation. Reported certification framework; certification is not automatically equivalent to every foreign-market legal requirement.
October 2026 edition; code year 2023 is not a certificate-issue date.

tables.title: GA A: selected source-linked recall facts (unverified)

cells: Article 14
The source links Article 14 to equality before law and equal protection of laws.
Unverified compilation. Static constitutional principle; brief notes are not a full account of permissible classification.
Undated polity compilation.
Article 21A
The source associates Article 21A with free and compulsory education for children aged 6–14.
Unverified compilation. Age-bounded constitutional provision; not all ages or all forms of education.
Undated polity compilation.
Articles 32 versus 226
Article 32 protects fundamental rights through the Supreme Court; Article 226 gives High Courts wider writ jurisdiction, including other legal rights.
Unverified compilation. Static jurisdiction distinction; procedural/legal exceptions are outside this compact row.
Undated polity compilation.
Article 246 and Seventh Schedule
The source links Article 246 to the Union, State and Concurrent legislative lists in the Seventh Schedule.
Unverified compilation. Allocation framework only; the notes' simplified 'only' and conflict rules must not erase constitutional exceptions.
Undated polity compilation; current legal text not authenticated.
UPSC: anniversary versus constitutional basis
The edition links the commission's historical origin to 1 October 1926 and Public Service Commissions to Articles 315–323.
Unverified compilation. News-to-static distinction; a centenary origin date is not the Constitution's commencement date.
October 2026 edition; historical origin 1 October 1926.
International Day of Older Persons
The October date table lists the observance on 1 October.
Unverified compilation. Selective fixed-date recall; the annual theme is deliberately not retained.
October 2026 edition; recurring observance, not a one-off launch.
International Day of Non-Violence
The October date table lists 2 October.
Unverified compilation. Selective fixed-date recall; do not infer a new scheme from the observance.
October 2026 edition; recurring observance.
